poll.source_locator: 'An internal DCCC poll conducted July 29 - 30 among 421 likely general election voters in AL-02 ... Figures and Republican nominee Rhett Marques are tied with 46% of the vote, as 8% of voters are undecided.' Methodology: 'via phone and text-to-web interviews. The margin of error is +/- 4.8%'
poll.notes: out_of_window (field end Jul 30); written as the only AL-02 poll since Jun 1 with full n/MoE/mode disclosure. Memo notes an R+9 party-ID edge in the sample and that 56% of residents of the new lines are Figures' existing constituents.
